description: Shared Chat projection cases (docs/chat.md, Projection). `events` are stored conversation events encoded exactly as `encode_stored_event` (one row of a `GET /v1/conversation-events` page); `expected` is the ordered output of `project_chat` for `conversation_id`. Played by pytest (jarvis/domain/chat_projection.py) and by node (jarvis/runtime/control_center_chat_model.js). Timestamps synthetic, ids constructed.

cases.name: user_addressed
cases.description: An `addressed` user turn and a user turn without `addressing` are both shown at once; the Brain reply is a bubble.

cases.name: uncertain_promoted
cases.description: An `uncertain` user turn is shown once a `brain.message.published` of the same `correlation_id` exists, at its own sequence (before the reply).

cases.name: uncertain_declined
cases.description: An `uncertain` turn the Brain declined (`[pas-pour-moi]`: no public outcome) is never promoted, even when other correlations get replies.

cases.name: republication_collapsed
cases.description: A publication equal to the previous publication of its correlation is folded into it (`collapse_published_messages`); the first one keeps its kind and status.

cases.name: aba_kept
cases.description: A, B, A stays three Brain bubbles: only a publication equal to the *previous* one of its correlation is folded. Every kind and the `failed` status are shown.

cases.name: turn_failed_on_user_turn
cases.description: `brain.turn.failed` is a status (`failure_code` = `attributes.code`) on the user bubble of the same correlation, never a bubble.

cases.name: turn_failed_on_system_turn_ignored
cases.description: A `brain.turn.failed` without a user bubble of its correlation (system turn, never recorded) is ignored and does not touch other bubbles.

cases.name: other_types_ignored
cases.description: `brain.turn.accepted`, `brain.work.*`, `subagent.*`, `brain.speech.requested` and `mouth.*` (reflex and speech, even public ones with content) never show.

cases.name: non_contiguous_sequences
cases.description: Sequences with gaps (rows filtered by `projection=chat`, unreadable rows) keep their own sequence; nothing is renumbered.

cases.name: page_replay
cases.description: A page replayed after a reconnect delivers the same `event_id`s again: items are keyed by `event_id`, the first copy wins, nothing is doubled or collapsed.

cases.name: two_conversations
cases.description: Only events of `conversation_id` count: another conversation's events are dropped and never promote, fold or fail a bubble here, even with the same `correlation_id`.

cases.name: unknown_addressing_excluded
cases.description: A user turn whose `addressing` is neither absent, `addressed` nor `uncertain` is excluded by prudence (`is_chat_event`); a Brain reply of its correlation is still a Brain bubble.

cases.name: turn_failed_other_conversation_same_correlation
cases.description: Another conversation shares the `correlation_id` of a user turn here: its identical publication never folds into this conversation's reply and its `brain.turn.failed` never becomes this bubble's status.

cases.name: turn_failed_then_reply_clears_failure
cases.description: A `brain.message.published` after the latest `brain.turn.failed` of the correlation clears `failure_code` (the reply arriving after the failure wins).

cases.name: reply_then_turn_failed_sets_failure
cases.description: A `brain.turn.failed` after the reply of the correlation still sets `failure_code` on the user bubble; the Brain bubble stays.
